name: systemd Unit & udev Rule Builder
blurb: a systemd service checked and drawn with its dependencies, and a udev rule written from udevadm info
intro: Checks a systemd .service file against systemd.service(5), systemd.unit(5), systemd.exec(5) and systemd.special(7) and draws where it sits in the boot (ordering, what it pulls in, what pulls it in); or turns `udevadm info -a` output into a udev rule, enforcing udev(7)'s rule that all parent keys match one parent device.

inputs.label: Unit file
inputs.default:
[Unit]
Description=Sensor bridge (Modbus RTU to MQTT)
Documentation=https://git.example.com/acme/sensor-bridge
After=network.target mosquitto.service
Wants=mosquitto.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=sensor
Group=dialout
ExecStart=/usr/bin/sensor-bridge --port /dev/ttyUSB0 --broker localhost:1883
Restart=always
StartLimitIntervalSec=60
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=full
PrivateDevices=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

inputs.label: udevadm info -a output
inputs.default:
Udevadm info starts with the device specified by the devpath and then
walks up the chain of parent devices. It prints for every device
found, all possible attributes in the udev rules key format.
A rule to match, can be composed by the attributes of the device
and the attributes from one single parent device.

usage: mode 'unit': give unitName and the unit file text in unit; it returns findings (errors, warnings, notes with line numbers) - wrong-section keys, ExecStart problems, Type/Restart combinations systemd refuses, After= without Wants=, network.target vs network-online.target, BindsTo without After, a missing [Install], PrivateDevices hiding a /dev node the program opens - the hardening switches that are on, a dependency table and the cleaned unit plus install/verify commands. mode 'udev': give udevInfo (udevadm info -a output), udevPick (KEY=="value" lines) and the assignments (symlink, perm (MODE), group, owner, tagSystemd, wants, actionAdd, ruleFile); it returns the rule file, where each key matches in the chain, errors when parent keys come from different parents or match nothing, and the reload/trigger/test commands.
sources: systemd.unit(5), systemd.service(5), systemd.exec(5), systemd.special(7), bootup(7) - freedesktop.org manual pages
udev(7) and udevadm(8) - rule keys, matching against one parent device, SYMLINK, TAG, SYSTEMD_WANTS
Yocto Project reference manual: systemd class (SYSTEMD_SERVICE, SYSTEMD_AUTO_ENABLE)
